article.story: MACON, Ga. -- — Armani Mighty scored 22 points and grabbed 13 rebounds to lead Mercer over Georgia State 78-67 on Tuesday night. Baraka Okojie scored 19 points and added five assists for the Bears (6-2). Quinton Perkins II had 15 points. The Panthers (1-8) were led by Jakai Newton, who recorded 18 points and eight rebounds. Micah Tucker added 16 points for Georgia State. Ayouba Berthe also had 13 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
